lines.trans: It has been three weeks for me.
But three weeks is nothing!
I am super terrible at being single.
I really hate that.
And you, how long has it been?
It has already been six months.
But I learned a great secret.
And what is it, your secret?
It is friendship, quite simply.
Would you like an herbal tea?
Yes, I would love an herbal tea.
I open the lid of the kettle.
I put some water inside.
And I turn on the switch.
Understood, that is very clear!
